content:
# B"H — 04 — Social Repair Plan

Social is the palace's living quarters — community presence is what makes the
palace LIVING rather than a museum. Every social surface must show signs of
life, or a truthful elegant quiet.

## 1. Design tokens (already in place — protect them)

- Midnight / cyan / violet / gold tokens exist under `.awtsmoos-social-root`.
- Scoping law: social styles live ONLY under that root. Leaks are defects.
- Classify every social stylesheet: ACTIVE / COMPATIBILITY / DORMANT / LEGACY /
  DEAD. No `!important` wars — resolve specificity by scoping, never escalation.
- Site chrome (nav, shells) renders from the SHARED tokens (05), so social
  feels like rooms of the same palace, not a different building.

## 2. Community composer — de-duplication proof (outstanding)

- The composer must provably not double-post (double-tap, retry storms,
  reconnect replays). Prior continuation flagged this as unproven.
- Plan: idempotency key per draft, single-flight submit, disabled-while-flying
  state with truthful feedback. Regression test as a new headless-node file
  for the state machine + a real-browser double-tap proof.

## 3. Social hub — route-by-route implementation (outstanding)

Prior REMAINING_WORK named profiles, search, notifications. Each route gets:
- profiles: identity hero with presence (arrival language, 05), real counts,
  activity signals, truthful empty states.
- search: useful at listing level; debounced; empty/error states that teach.
- notifications: real data, recency hierarchy, mark-read that stays read.
- Every route: one-tap Home (gating), breadcrumbs where depth exists, the
  shared motion language (staggered entrances, tactile press), reduced-motion
  counterparts.

## 4. Signs of life (the "but better" mandate)

- Recent learning, community presence, continuing paths — surfaced wherever
  the data exists: activity signals, counts, progress.
- Where data is absent: elegant quiet. Never fabricated members, never fake
  activity. Truthful empty states ARE the luxury finish.

## 5. File plan (source law)

- Read before writing; rewrite complete files; tabs; no minify; ~120-line
  modules; read-after-write; preserve public contracts or trace consumers.
- Composer, profile renderer, search module, notifications renderer — separate.

## 6. Verification

- Route-by-route embarrassment walk; one-tap Home on every social route;
  390/430; RTL; reduced-motion; keyboard. Takeover tests continuous.
